exec docker build -qt local-updater .

# Without --local, repo dir doesn't exist -> should fail
! dependabot update go_modules dependabot-fixtures/go-modules-lib --updater-image local-updater
stderr 'No such file or directory'

# With --local, CLI should create repo dir and mount my-repo into it
dependabot update go_modules dependabot-fixtures/go-modules-lib --updater-image local-updater --local my-repo
! stderr 'No such file or directory'

# Should see repo contents and dummy commit
stderr \.git
stderr hello.txt
stderr 'Dependabot CLI automated commit'

# When my-repo is a clean git repo, CLI should NOT create its own commit
exec git -C my-repo init
exec git -C my-repo config user.name "Test User"
exec git -C my-repo config user.email "test@example.com"
exec git -C my-repo add hello.txt
exec git -C my-repo commit -m 'assert this in the test'

dependabot update go_modules dependabot-fixtures/go-modules-lib --updater-image local-updater --local my-repo
stderr 'hello.txt'
stderr 'assert this in the test'

# When my-repo is dirty, CLI should auto-commit so changes aren't lost
exec echo 'make an uncommited change' >> my-repo/hello.txt
exec touch my-repo/goodbye.txt

dependabot update go_modules dependabot-fixtures/go-modules-lib --updater-image local-updater --local my-repo
stderr 'hello.txt'
stderr 'goodbye.txt'
stderr 'Dependabot CLI automated commit'

exec docker rmi -f local-updater

-- Dockerfile --
FROM ubuntu:24.04

RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends git ca-certificates && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* && \
    useradd -m dependabot && \
    mkdir -p /home/dependabot/dependabot-updater && \
    chown -R dependabot:dependabot /home/dependabot && \
    chgrp dependabot /etc/ssl/certs && chmod g+w /etc/ssl/certs

COPY --chown=dependabot:dependabot --chmod=755 run bin/run

USER dependabot
WORKDIR /home/dependabot

-- run --
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e
ls -a /home/dependabot/dependabot-updater/repo
git -C /home/dependabot/dependabot-updater/repo log -1 --pretty=format:%s 2>/dev/null || true

-- my-repo/hello.txt --
Hello, world!
